page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with x86_64 architecture. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and is equipped with a 480 MB L3 cache. The server is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 2835 GB NVMe SSD, and it supports Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the D48ds_v7 demonstrates strong performance across multiple vectors. Its memory subsystem achieves high read-only small block bandwidth of 3733.43 GB/sec and large block write bandwidth of 106.22 GB/sec. Computational capabilities are highlighted by a Passmark CPU score of 68963.55 and strong extended instructions performance, aided by hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions. Database and key-value store operations are highly efficient, with Redis SET operations reaching 84.18 million operations per second and Passmark database operations scoring in the top tier. Single-threaded gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also register strong throughput rates.

From a resource density perspective, the D48ds_v7 offers balanced cost efficiency by pairing a high-frequency Intel Xeon processor with a substantial local NVMe SSD. This combination eliminates the need for separate external storage attachments for high-I/O operations, optimizing the overall cost-to-performance ratio for data-intensive applications. The server is well-suited for relational databases, high-throughput web serving, Redis caching layers, and moderate-scale machine learning inference tasks, such as running 7B parameter LLM models where it achieves prompt processing speeds of 239.1 tokens per second.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Ddsv7 family, powered by a 48-vCPU Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running at 4.2 GHz on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 192.0 GB of RAM, a 480 MB L3 cache, and a bundled 2835 GB NVMe SSD for high-speed local storage. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX. In benchmark testing, the server exhibits strong performance, notably achieving 84.18 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 72.52 GB/sec in static web serving, and strong memory bandwidth. Qualitative cost efficiency is high due to the integrated high-capacity NVMe storage and balanced compute-to-memory ratio. This server is optimized for database hosting, high-throughput web serving, caching layers, and medium-scale LLM inference workloads.
